name: check_availability
description: Find free appointment times. Use it before offering any time to the caller. Without a date it returns the earliest free times; with a date it returns free times on that day. For emergencies use treatment "emergency" with today's date.

treatment.description: The visit type the caller wants.

date.description: Day to check, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out to get the earliest free times.

dentist.description: Only if the caller asks for a specific dentist.

name: book_appointment
description: Book an appointment at one of the free times returned by check_availability. Only call it after the caller has confirmed the time, and you have their full name and phone number.

phone.description: Caller's phone number, digits as spoken.

dentist.description: The dentist of the chosen free time.

start.description: The 'start' value of the chosen free time, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

name: find_appointments
description: Find the caller's upcoming appointments by phone number. Use it before rescheduling or cancelling, to get the appointment_id.

phone.description: Caller's phone number, digits as spoken.

name: reschedule_appointment
description: Move an existing appointment to a new free time. First use find_appointments to get the appointment_id, and check_availability for the new time. Only call it after the caller confirms the new time.

new_start.description: The 'start' value of the new free time, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

dentist.description: The dentist of the new free time.

name: cancel_appointment
description: Cancel an existing appointment. First use find_appointments to get the appointment_id, and confirm with the caller which appointment to cancel.
